description.narrative: The objective of the Digital Government for Resilience in Grenada is to enhance the efficiency, usage and resilience of selected government digital services. This project has three components. Component(1) Developing the enabling environment to modernize service delivery. This component will establish the technical, institutional, legal and regulatory foundations that provide the enabling environment to enhance internal administrative efficiencies and collaboration across government entities. Component(2) Leveraging digital technologies to deliver selected services. The objective of this component is to enable the delivery of two high-priority public services through digital technologies. Component (3) Strengthening institutions and managing change for digital literacy and inclusion. The objective of this component is to strengthen the institutional and human capacity to manage digital government transformation.
To enhance the efficiency, usage and resilience of selected government digital services.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I.A.2.The Recipient, through the Ministry shall maintain a Project manager to manage the implementation of theProject, including the coordination and collaboration among key stakeholders and any other agencies of the Recipient, withqualifications, terms of reference, and under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association and as set forth in the ProjectOperations Manual

Schedule 2, Section I.A.4. The Recipient shall operate and maintain a Project Oversight Committee throughout the implementation ofthe Project to monitor Project implementation and provide guidance on policy and institutional matters, with a composition andtermsof reference satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.5. The Recipient shall operate and maintain Technical Advisory Committees throughout the implementation ofthe Project to assist with the technical oversight of the Project, with a composition and terms of reference satisfactory to theAssociation.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.6. The Recipient shall retain an environmental and social specialist in accordance with Section 5.13 of theGeneral Conditions, with qualifications, terms of reference, and under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1. The Recipient, through the Ministry, shall carry out the Project in accordance with the provisions of amanual (the “Project Operations Manual”) acceptable to the Association.
Schedule 2, Section I.C.1. The Recipient shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordance with the Environmental andSocial Standards, in a manner acceptable to the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.C.5. The Recipient shall maintain and publicize the availability of a grievance mechanism, in form andsubstance satisfactory to the Association, to hear and determine fairly and in good faith all complaints raised in relation to theProject, and take all measures necessary to implement the determinations made by such mechanism in a manner satisfactory to theAssociation.
Schedule 2, Section II. The Recipient shall furnish to the Association each Project Report not later than one month after the endof each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester.

The Recipient shall retain the services throughout Project implementation of a Project Management and Technical Advisory Firm inaccordance with Section 5.13 of the General Conditions, to assist with Project implementation and provide advisory services to theRecipient, with qualifications, terms of reference, and under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association.
